overview.content:
Every page: sidebar groups, then their pages; a page opened from another is indented under it (from the control that opens it). After each, what it offers, by where it is (a menu, a tab), most telling first; "…": more.
Generation:
- Voices /voices: Add Voice, Switch account, Library, Play …
  - Create Voice /voices/create (from Add Voice): Generate, Direction, Mood, Language, Name, Notes, Pitch, Style …
Create:
- Studio /studio: The Type tool: Add text; Toggle keyframe …
Opened by address only:
- Unbound /unbound: Unbound (/unbound).
On every page (the app’s frame): Assistant
Go to any page by its address with [app_navigate]. An item's page (its route has an :id) opens from the page above it.
overview.title: The app’s pages

detail.content:
Offers Add text, Toggle keyframe, Save PNG, Save SVG and Select, among 7 actions.
Where: the sidebar, Create › Studio.

Board (on this page): The page around the demo room.
Actions:
- Save SVG [demo_board_save_svg]: Header › Save SVG
- Save PNG [demo_board_save_png]: Header › Save PNG
What it reports: problems — What is wrong that a person would see: what the page cannot show, load or do, as its banners and messages say it. Empty when nothing is wrong.

Demo Room (on this page): Draws shapes and text.
Actions:
- Add text [demo_room_add_text]: The Type tool (T)
- Select [demo_room_select]: Clicking a layer
- Toggle keyframe [demo_room_toggle_keyframe]: The diamond beside a field
Fields, set with [demo_room_set_properties] under values, by id (each one's meaning, range and unit are in that tool's input):
- Type: Tracking (tracking)
- Transform: Angle (angle)
- Time: Time (playhead-time)
Commands, run with [demo_room_run_command] (what each does is in that tool's input):
- objects: Group (object.group, ⌘G)
Not built yet (their keys do nothing): Knife.
What it reports: document — Every layer. problems — What is wrong that a person would see: what the page cannot show, load or do, as its banners and messages say it. Empty when nothing is wrong.

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
detail.title: Studio (/studio)

recipes.name: Fix what the Board reports
steps: Read problems: each says what is wrong, what it hides, and which action resolves it.
Resolve each with the action it names, using one of the choices it offers.
Read the room’s observations and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: problems lists anything, or the user cannot see something

recipes.name: Change a property in the Demo Room
steps: Find its id in document.
Select it with demo_room_select.
Set the fields that apply to its kind with demo_room_set_properties, giving their ids under values (the relationships say which).
Read document and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: Changing how something already in the Demo Room looks

recipes.name: Add text and style it
steps: Make it with demo_room_add_text; the result names it and it is selected.
Style it with demo_room_set_properties, using the fields that apply to what it made.
Read document and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: Making something new with Add text in the Demo Room

recipes.name: Animate a property in the Demo Room
steps: Select what should animate.
Turn on the property's keyframe with demo_room_toggle_keyframe.
Move the playhead with demo_room_set_properties playhead-time.
Change the value with demo_room_set_properties: at the new time it is a new keyframe. Keyframeable: angle.
Read document and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: Making something move or change over time in the Demo Room

recipes.name: Fix what the Demo Room reports
steps: Read problems: each says what is wrong, what it hides, and which action resolves it.
Resolve each with the action it names, using one of the choices it offers.
Read document and problems; if something is not drawn, fix that before saying it is done.
recipes.trigger: problems lists anything, or the user cannot see something

relationships.content:
In the Demo Room, document accepts: Time (playhead-time).
In the Demo Room, shape accepts: Angle (angle).
In the Demo Room, text accepts: Tracking (tracking), Angle (angle).
Keyframeable (set at the playhead, a keyframe there when animated): Angle.
These make something new and select it: Add text.
These change what is selected, which fields act on: Select.

detail.content:
Your voice library. Voices shared with your account.
Where: the sidebar, Generation › Voices.

What you can do here (tool in brackets):
On the page:
- Add Voice [voices_add] (goes to /voices/create)
- Delete [voices_bulk_delete] (confirm first)
- Library [voices_library]
- Open [voices_open] (one per row)
- Play [voices_play]
- Choose (Portrait) [voices_portrait]
- Open [voices_row] (one per row)
- Choose (Samples) [voices_samples]
- Sort [voices_sort]
- Switch account [voices_switch_account] (confirm first)
In the "Delete Voices" dialog (open it with voices_bulk_delete):
- Cancel (Delete Voices) [voices_bulk_delete_cancel]: Keep them.
- Confirm (Delete Voices) [voices_bulk_delete_confirm]: Delete them. (saves through deleteVoice (DELETE /api/v1/voices/{voiceId}))
In the "Rename" dialog (open it with voices_rename):
- Rename [voices_rename_dialog]: The rename dialog.
- Name [voices_rename_name]: The new name. Takes value: string.
On the "Account Voices" tab (select it with voices_library):
- Rename [voices_rename]: Rename the account.

What it shows (read it in its state, under shown, by id):
- Parameters (Engine, Seed) [voices.parameters]: The library’s generation parameters

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
detail.title: Voices (/voices)

recipes.name: Use the "Delete Voices" dialog
steps: Open it with voices_bulk_delete.
Finish with Confirm (Delete Voices) [voices_bulk_delete_confirm].
Read the page's state and problems in the result, and tell the user only what they confirm.

recipes.name: Use the "Rename" dialog
steps: Be on the "Account Voices" tab (select it with voices_library).
Open it with voices_rename.
Set what it asks for: Name [voices_rename_name].
Read the page's state and problems in the result, and tell the user only what they confirm.

steps: Find the row in the page state's lists: its key (id) and title.
Call the row's tool with it as item: Open [voices_open], Open [voices_row].
Read the page's state and problems in the result, and tell the user only what they confirm.
